verdict.headline: NOT YET - no statistically clear edge; the fix behaves like an ordinary price level so far.
details: At the fix level price bounced 36% of the time (397 touches) vs 41% at placebo levels (-5 pts, p=0.0747).
Magnet beta: fix 0.0055 (t=0.47) vs placebo 0.0052 (t=0.54). Negative = price pulled back toward the level.
